name: outpost
description: Default burden bank for Outpost (sci-fi station scenario). Secrets, debts, and prophecies for crew under closed-system pressure.

burdens.text: I have been editing my official biometric reports. The medic does not know my real heart rate.
On my last station rotation, a crewmate died. The official record blames a system failure. It was my mistake.
I have a corporate handler. They expect a private report at the end of this rotation. I have not yet decided what to send.
I am dying. The Surgeon will diagnose it within four turns if she examines me. I have not told anyone.
I am here as restitution for a crime nobody on this crew knows about. My contract ends only when the company says so.
Before I deployed, an oracle told me I would never see Earth again. I do not believe in oracles. The thought has not left me.
I am in love with a member of this crew. They do not know. I do not intend to tell them.
